articles.summary: A Fast and Cost-Effective Way to Develop a PDU with Integrated Emergency Safety Functions nVent Electric plc (NYSE:NVT) (“nVent”), a global leader in electrical connection and protection solutions, recently announced the U.S. launch of the nVent SCHROFF Rack Safety Plus power distribution unit (PDU), an innovative safety solution designed for both partially and fully automated test systems.
articles.title: nVent Introduces Rack Safety Plus: UL-Certified Modular Power Distribution Unit with Emergency Stop Designed for U.S. Customers
